candidates.prompt: Edit the FIRST reference into an exquisite bespoke high-resolution hand-painted battle material for Legend of Dragoon's gorgeous AA 2026 retro remaster. SECOND reference is original source authority: preserve all major source forms, original palette and layout from it. Muted gray-green weathered stone with the existing round-topped raised ledge in the upper left-center and the larger angular stone-edged dark recess toward lower right. Preserve their exact contours, shading and positions. Fine mineral grain only, no added alcoves, brick joints or new cracks. Retain the right thin leafy/rock fragment and bottom neighboring stone cutouts. Flat atlas crop with exactly the same 72:72 aspect ratio and full-canvas composition. Make continuous fine hand-painted surface detail, removing enlarged square source pixels and blurry neural smears; keep the original broad material pattern subdued, without increasing relief depth. No new recognizable objects, buildings, ornaments, symbols, moss patches, roots, cracks, branches, reflections or scenery. No extra directional lighting, strong specular glare, bloom, dramatic shadows, text, perspective, framing, cropping or rotation. Preserve black and white source empty areas.
